Isgarren,  
  
I have some good news, and I have some odd news.  
  
The good news: we have confirmed the absence of any further titan activity on the scale of Ura, Greer, and Decima across Janthir Syntri and Lowland Shore.  
  
The odd news: this has not fixed anything.  
  
Lest you misunderstand, the situation is no longer deteriorating. We've seen some improvement in the vitality of regional flora and fauna. Narcisse informs me the salmon are "floppier than ever." But, given all we know, I would expect rather more recovery progress...and far fewer titanspawn.  
  
The titans' defeat at the hand of the wayfinder should have brought about a more robust shift in the environment. After injury or illness, the body rights itself once more to equilibrium. However, our readings do not support projections of an upward recovery trend in Janthiri wildlife (and my researchers assure me it is not a byproduct of faulty equipment this time). Scouts continue to report titanspawn sightings across the isles, and Mistburned populations remain troublingly steady in number.  
  
In a word: enervation. If I were to guess, I'd say vital energies required for the land to recover are being drained or redirected, somehow. A side effect of the bloodstone fallout in Syntri? It does seem unlikely based on what we know, but nothing can be ruled out where nasty little cultists are involved.  
  
We shall continue to, as they say, "hold down the fort" in your absence as we endeavor to uncover the root of this quandary.  
  
Though, knowing the wayfinder, I suspect whatever's causing it will find you first.  
  
Enjoy the haunted ruins!  
  
—Zizel
